htf_bias_gate_evidence: Tier 1 truth kernels now propagate macro_bias_kernel, htf_zone_kernel, and liquidity_map_kernel into Phase 3 and Phase 4 artifacts.
Those truth primitives currently modulate projection and charge confirmation rather than acting as a hard upstream admission gate.
level_awareness_evidence: Phase 1 still computes local zone_state such as NEAR_FLOOR, NEAR_CEILING, MID_ZONE.
Tier 1 truth kernels now add higher-level structural hints through htf_zone_kernel and liquidity_map_kernel.
The remaining weakness is not total absence of structural awareness, but insufficiently strict use of those kernels as doctrine admission constraints.
entry_foundation_read: The stack is no longer purely local-pattern driven because truth kernels are carried into the later tiers.
But most failing doctrines are still not being filtered or instantiated strongly enough by those global truth primitives before downstream replay.
The likely foundation gap is weak enforcement and composition, not missing truth-kernel transport.
foundation_audit.most_likely_foundation_problem: Global truth primitives exist, but they are still acting more like soft modifiers than hard doctrine-shaping admission truth.

notes: This is the locked repair map for the currently failing doctrines in the latest salvage audit snapshot.
Track 1 and Track 2 are parallel workstreams because they address different structural failure classes.
EXPANSION_RELEASE_LONG is no longer treated as a pure identity failure because it now instantiates and mainly leaks through T6 charge and decay.
Retired-disabled doctrines are excluded from the active failure queue because they are no longer runtime blockers.
